name: tenon
description: Tenon language (.tn): syntax highlighting, and diagnostics, hover, go to definition and completion from the Tenon language server

tenon.serverPath.description: The tenon executable (tools/install.sh), started as `tenon lsp`; a name is looked up on PATH.

tenon.root.description: The Tenon toolchain root, the directory holding lib/prelude.tn and lib/std/ (passed as --root). Empty: a workspace folder that contains lib/prelude.tn, else $TENON_ROOT, else the root next to the executable.
